The raid note for Twin Fangs (Mythic), checked against every The Twin Fangs pull (39), each until its wipe was decided (the boss's enrage or half the raid dead) and against the note as it was saved before it began. "p3 1:15" is pull 3 at 1:15.
The note's kick order fits pulls 12-39, not 1-11, which had another: there, Kick #2 left was kicked by Dragepie (15 of its 19 casts), Kick #5 left was kicked by Slushmania (10 of its 13 casts), and Attractîv, named in the note, was in none of them (tanks' kicks on others' assignments left out as backup). Kicks are counted for pulls 12-39 only; soaks and cooldowns for every pull.

Kick assignments (a callout to one player when an add begins a cast someone kicked on this boss that night). Which side's add begins first varies, so a note timed for one side is a second off for the other: each wave is read as noted or with each pair's casts swapped, whichever has more players kicking their own, and a kick on another cast begun within 1.5 s of the callout counts too. Over the pulls, per player, most casts that went through first: of their kicks while alive, how many they made, how many another player covered (kicked their cast first: handled, no one's miss; by whom), and the casts of theirs that weren't kicked (they went through unless it says otherwise; with the cast of the wave they kicked instead, if any); dead for how many more:
  Enfo (Kick #2 right): kicked 50 of 59; covered 5 (Karadim 5); not kicked 4: p13 0:40, p20 3:15, p32 1:41, p37 6:51
  The raid, for scale: 10 players kicked 448 of 569 while alive; 93 covered, 28 not kicked
